description: Bundled VRM pool for angel — abison's 5 hand-picked anime-girl avatars from VRoid Hub mapped to the four aesthetic archetypes in shared/src/persona.ts (A1=cottagecore, A2=tech-minimal, A3=y2k-cyber, A4=dark-academia) plus a 5th alt slot. Old schema_v2 alts (alt-1-aimee-glasses, alt-2-streetwear-beanie, cc0-aesthetica) are preserved as backup. Hackathon build — visual quality is the priority.
registry_source: https://hub.vroid.com/en — abison-curated picks (5 specific URLs, no agent substitutions)

license_notes.VRoidHub-RedistributionDisallow: 4 of the 5 abison picks have license redistribution=disallow per VRoid Hub metadata. We're shipping them anyway under a research/educational-use rationale (hackathon demo only) and via the public viewer-preview asset path, but they SHOULD NOT ship in production builds without contacting the creators. Modification=allow on all but cyber.vrm; credit=unnecessary; characterization_allowed_user=everyone.
license_notes.VRoidHub-Permissive: Old schema-v2 alts (alt-1-aimee-glasses, alt-2-streetwear-beanie) had redistribution=allow.
license_notes.CC0: cc0-aesthetica fallback is public domain — safe for production.

models.name: あん ワンピースとキャスケット (an — one-piece + casquette)
models.creator: マッハさぬき (Mach Sanuki)
models.attribution: あん by マッハさぬき — https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/2518144517136640917/models/501019205687594625
models.slot_rationale: Orange casquette + white ruffled blouse + pink/orange plaid pinafore dress + blonde bob. Warm pastel palette, summery flowy silhouette → reads as cottagecore (A1). Strongest of the 5 picks for soft/grounded warmth.

models.name: あゆ 等身上げ＋ぱつぱつチューブトップ (ayu — taller proportions + tight tube top)
models.creator: マッハさぬき (Mach Sanuki)
models.attribution: あゆ by マッハさぬき — https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/4813823216579728044/models/1196651590280960171
models.slot_rationale: Silver/white short hair, white tube-top + black bolero with brown belt detail, jeweled choker. Sleek monochrome (white/black/silver) silhouette with a single accent → strongest tech-minimal read of the 5 (A2). Note: this is the only one with redistribution=allow per the API metadata, though the VRM file's embedded license still says Redistribution_Prohibited (mismatch — treat as restricted).

models.name: サンプル チェッカーフラッグワンピース (sample — checkered-flag one-piece)
models.creator: しろくろ (Shirokuro)
models.attribution: サンプル by しろくろ — https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/893465807550967786/models/7210459107638446374
models.vrm_meta_title: チェッカーフラッグワンピース
models.slot_rationale: Red/white racing-checkered one-piece dress, dark-brown bob with bright yellow streaks, large amber eyes. Sharp graphic patterning + Y2K-racing-girl energy reads as cyber/edgy/y2k (A3). Note: this is the strictest license of the 5 (modification also disallowed) — flag explicitly.

models.name: いずみ (izumi — spring fashion)
models.creator: マッハさぬき (Mach Sanuki)
models.attribution: いずみ by マッハさぬき — https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/1498003513922110214/models/377131882405400730
models.slot_rationale: Long brown hair with side braid, white ruffled blouse with gingham trim cuffs, dark-navy jumper dress with bow detail. Argyle background. Library-girl uniform silhouette → textbook dark academia (A4). Highest spring-bone count (30) of the 5 = best hair physics.

models.name: いくの (ikuno — streetwear)
models.creator: マッハさぬき (Mach Sanuki)
models.attribution: いくの by マッハさぬき — https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/7789234524817677542/models/1338125788676898134
models.slot_rationale: Brown bob, light-grey 'HEAVY DUTY' cropped hoodie, deep-blue eyes. Casual streetwear/cozy fit. Doesn't fit any of the 4 archetypes as cleanly as the other picks — became the 5th alt slot. Could swap in for cottagecore if a less pastel option is wanted, or used as a default 'just hanging out' persona.

models.name: Aimee Vexx — Casual Outfit 2
models.creator: NorthrnPoakr
models.notes: Pink twin-braids + glasses + black/white striped top + pleated skirt. Sweet-academia / library-girl aesthetic. Backup for A4 or for a 5th persona slot.

models.name: とわだぱカヒラ (Towada Pakahira) — Valentine Coord

models.attribution: とわだぱカヒラ by kurosakiworks
models.notes: Blonde short hair under brown beanie, oversized cardigan, denim shorts + leg warmers. Streetwear/cozy fit — alt for cottagecore-meets-tech vibe.
